description: This PHP class `EmbeddedURLForYoutube` extends an abstract class and provides functionality to extract embedded YouTube URLs from a given URL. It includes methods to identify whether a URL is a YouTube URL and to transform it into an embed form, throwing an exception for invalid URLs.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForYoutube
classes.description: A class that processes URLs to identify and convert YouTube URLs to embed links, inheriting from AbstractBuzzVideoURL.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns the YouTube embed URL if the original URL is a valid YouTube URL; throws an exception if invalid.
